title: RequestRecord
description: The persisted correlation record for one `request_id`.

outcome.description: The original response value once the request reached a terminal state.

payload_hash.description:
Hash of the request payload this id was first used for (SF-006).
Additive and optional: records written before SF-006 have none, and a
record without one is not dedupeable (see [`RequestCorrelationStore::check`]).

RequestStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a correlated request.
